description: Application to Estimate the Relative Density Profile from Centrifuge Cone Penetration Tests (Ottawa Sand F65) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Alejandro Sepulveda, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (rpi.edu). This standalone application allows users to estimate relative density profiles from in-flight cone penetration test (CPT) profiles. This correlation is valid for Ottawa sand f65 and was developed by Sepulveda, A. and Zeghal, M. (2024). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-pphm-fz53. Keywords: LEAP, Relative Density, Cone Penetration Test, Centrifuge Data, Visualizations, Standalone MATLAB APP.. Published 2023-12-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
